sources_fetched.title: Client Contacts – Harvest API V2 Documentation

record.name: Harvest
record.one_liner: Harvest API V2 provides programmatic access via REST using Personal Access Tokens or OAuth2 for managing time tracking, projects, clients, invoices, and estimates.

auth.notes: Supports both Personal Access Tokens and a full OAuth2 Authorization Code flow.

access.notes: Developers can create Personal Access Tokens or register OAuth2 applications directly from the Developers section of Harvest ID.

api_surface.notes: Offers a REST API v2 with endpoints for clients, company settings, invoices, estimates, expenses, tasks, timesheets, projects, roles, users, reports, and paid time off.

buildability.reasoning: Self-service credentials can be generated directly in the Harvest ID developer console, and the API is thoroughly documented with curl and Postman examples.

evidence.claim: Lists the various API V2 modules available, such as Clients, Invoices, Tasks, Timesheets, and Projects.
Describes authentication options including Personal Access Tokens created from the Developers section of Harvest ID and full OAuth2 flow.
Provides REST API endpoint details and curl examples for interacting with client contacts.
